retry_token.description: The retry token provided by a previous incomplete or failed function execution.

from_cache.description: If true, vector completion tasks use cached votes from the global ObjectiveAI votes cache when available. Has lower priority than `retry_token`, higher priority than `from_rng`.

from_rng.description: If true, any remaining votes from vector completion tasks are generated via RNG. Has lower priority than `retry_token` or `from_cache`.

items.description: The upstream provider that served the request.

strategy.description: Strategy for function execution. Defaults to 'default'. Use 'swiss_system' for vector functions to run tournament-style ranking across multiple rounds.

anyOf.description: If provided, a reasoning summary for the Function Execution will be generated. This reasoning summary attempts to detail why the final Output is what it is, based on AI assertions made during execution.

input.description: A value provided as input to a function.

anyOf.description: Options for selecting the upstream provider of this completion.
If specified, upstream systems will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
The maximum total time in milliseconds to spend on retries when a transient error occurs.
The maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the first chunk of a streaming response.
The maximum time in milliseconds to wait between subsequent chunks of a streaming response.

A scalar function defined inline. Each task's output expression must return a number in [0,1]. The function's output is the weighted average of all task outputs using profile weights. If there is only one task, its output becomes the function's output directly.

A vector function defined inline. Each task's output expression must return an array of numbers summing to ~1. The function's output is the weighted average of all task outputs using profile weights. If there is only one task, its output becomes the function's output directly.
Whether to stream the response as a series of chunks.

description: Parameters for executing an inline function with a remote profile.
